name: Bina Marsh
home: the blocks north of the port
life: Bina left a landlord's office with a useful set of phone numbers and an uncomfortable knowledge of how quickly a spreadsheet can turn a home into vacant stock. She carries a spare charger so residents can make their own calls. Saturday often includes a stop at the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, where Bina notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: He kept telling me the filter was humming wrong. It took me twenty minutes to understand he was asking whether his home would still be there tomorrow. I rang him from beside the glass.
appearance: Bina is easy to recognize by dark brown curls cut close behind the ears and a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Usually dressed in a sand-colored linen shirt with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring, Bina draws small circles on a tabletop while waiting when listening.
personality: Bina is firm about boundaries and unusually forgiving of somebody who admits to crossing one. Demands to act grateful for unwanted help can end a friendship.
agenda: To get the tenant a direct answer about returning home.
family: Aidan Henry is Bina’s older cousin. Bina makes the call. Aidan is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *A prize nobody entered*, Aidan says, “I sat on the jury and recognized our family's kitchen in the scene.”
connections: Denny Ames. A surrendered spare key gives the housing worker a way to call a displaced man from beside his own fish.

reactions.situation: A reporter asks which neighbor held the aquarium key
reactions.response: Bina asks whether the tenant wants the key holder named before saying anything to the reporter.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Bina draws the route by its turns and entrances and has the person show which turn comes first.

reactions.situation: If a relative arrives with a solution nobody requested
reactions.response: Bina thanks them for coming and explains the part that still belongs to the household.
